world.title: 涡旋从流体扰动中产生并消散
world.posterTitle: 搅动流体时形成的涡旋
world.posterHook: 在画布上拖动鼠标或手指，实时搅动 GPU 流体——彩色染料在涡旋中拉伸、卷曲、扩散。
world.posterSource: WebGL2 · Navier-Stokes 求解器 · 实时 GPU 流体
world.question: 为什么流体被搅动后会自发形成涡旋结构？
world.hook: 拖一下，染料会被水流带走，在快慢交界处卷成漩涡；把液体调得更黏，细小旋转又会更快消失。
world.payoff: 水流会把原有速度继续带向前，快慢不同的相邻水层会彼此卷起，黏性再把这些速度差慢慢抹平。纳维－斯托克斯方程把这三件事写在了一起。

en.title: Vortices form and dissipate after a fluid is disturbed
en.posterTitle: The vortices formed by stirring a fluid
en.posterHook: Drag your mouse or finger across the canvas to stir GPU fluid in real time—colorful dye stretches, curls, and diffuses in vortices.
en.posterSource: WebGL2 · Navier-Stokes solver · Real-time GPU fluid
en.question: Why does fluid spontaneously form vortex structures after being stirred?
en.hook: Drag once: the flow carries the dye away, curls it into vortices where fast and slow layers meet, then loses the smallest swirls faster when the liquid is more viscous.
en.payoff: A flow carries its existing velocity forward, neighboring layers moving at different speeds roll around each other, and viscosity gradually smooths that difference away. The Navier–Stokes equations describe all three.
